A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md` file (instructions, conventions, examples) and, when needed, scripts. Agents such as Claude Code load a skill only when the task calls for it, so it can be long and specific without cluttering every conversation.

Each skill here can be downloaded as a folder, says which agents and models it was tested with, and lists its known limits.
